evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/dashboard/hooks/useActionQueue.ts:282-297 — executeAction useMutation is a mocked stub: mutationFn contains `// TODO: Replace with actual API call`, only awaits a 500ms setTimeout and always returns { success: true }; user-facing dashboard actions (dismiss/approve/complete via dismissItem:302 and handleAction:310) silently no-op against the backend.
No onError handler on the mutation either, so once the real API call is wired in, failures would still be invisible to the user.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/iot/hooks/useIotWebSocket.ts:32-36 — buildWsUrl reads window.__API_BASE_URL__ through an `as unknown as Record<string, unknown>` cast; when the global is unset, httpBase falls back to '' and the function returns a path-only string ('/api/v1/iot/sensors/ws?...') which `new WebSocket()` rejects (WS URLs must be absolute), so the IoT live feed silently fails to connect in any deployment that doesn't inject the global.
Fix: fall back to a derived absolute origin (location.origin with ws/wss scheme swap) or VITE_API_BASE_URL instead of ''.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/hooks/usePerformanceMetrics.ts:178-191 — exported logPerformanceMetrics() ships ~9 console.log/console.group calls in committed code; guarded by import.meta.env.DEV but the dead branch still lands in source and the metrics never reach any real monitoring sink — consider routing to an analytics/monitoring API or stripping the util.
